mode: Market controls sound; original patch UI is read only

selection.samples: Activity: gait / wood; motion: toy; otherwise earings. Supplied files only; five-second stable state before replacement.
selection.envelopes: Activity: ultra percussion / complex percussion / relaxed; motion: sharpy. Each selected bank has 1000 rows.
selection.sequence: Market activity chooses 1–8 sixteenth-note division; direction / volume / motion choose row base. Counter advances deterministically; no random row or speed draw.

limitations: DSP oscillator phases and grain synthesis retain the supplied implementation.
Inactive alternative presets, uploaders, local-folder scanners and calibration messages are disabled, not triggered by coin data.
Source initialization, normalization and bounded gain constants remain fixed.
OHLC replay has no historical liquidity or buy/sell split: dry reverb and centered pan; activity is a volume proxy.
